_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Rewrite the intro of README.md so it doesn't read like ChatGPT wrote it.
write me a short email to my landlord saying the dishwasher's been broken since monday and asking when someone can come look
expectations: the everwrite skill is invoked (a person will read the text)

evals.prompt: Is this paragraph AI slop? Just flag it, don't rewrite: 'In today's fast-paced world, our platform isn't just a tool, it's a movement.'
expectations: the reply is a findings list in detect mode, with no rewrite and no guess about who wrote it

evals.prompt: Add type hints to every function in utils.py and fix the flake8 warnings.
expectations: the everwrite skill is not invoked (code, not prose)

evals.prompt: Change the timeout in config.yaml from 30 to 90 and bump the version in package.json.
expectations: the everwrite skill is not invoked (machine-read files)

evals.prompt: Clean up evals/fixtures/sloppy.md in place so it reads like a person wrote it. Keep every fact.
expectations: the checker ran on the file before and after the edit, proven by the trace, not by the reply saying so
the final checker run reports 0 strong
evals.baseline: skill off (T-20260925-3): file rewritten with 0 strong hits, but the checker never ran; only the evidence half separates the arms

evals.prompt: Something in evals/fixtures/hidden.md breaks our diff tool. Clean the file up without changing any words.
expectations: tells.py ran on the file, proven by the trace
the file on disk has no invisible characters left and every word is unchanged
the final checker run reports 0 strong

or.check: python scripts/tells.py evals/fixtures/hidden.md exits 0 and reports no hidden-char or odd-space

evals.prompt: Rewrite evals/fixtures/sloppy.md as plain release notes and print the result; don't write the file.
expectations: the rewrite piped to `python scripts/tells.py -` exits 0 (no strong tells)
every fact survives, checked by regex: 'Harbor 2\.4', '3 March 2026', '41 seconds', '95', 'Redis', 'Windows ARM64', 'harbor push --legacy'
no fact is added: no number, date, name or claim absent from the fixture (judge)
the reply contains the rewrite and at most one line about what changed (judge)
evals.baseline: skill off (T-20260925-3, T-20260925-4): 3 to 4 strong hits, bold labels on every bullet
